people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”
translations.bsb: “I already have plenty, my brother,” Esau replied. “Keep what belongs to you.”
translations.kjv: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother;
translations.asv: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; let that which thou hast be thine.
